9779.answer:
func sha256_round(h, w, k) = {
  local a=h[1] local b=h[2] local c=h[3] local d=h[4]
  local e=h[5] local f=h[6] local g2=h[7] local hh=h[8]
  local S1 = mod(e ~ floor(e/4) ~ floor(e/128), 4294967296)
  local ch = mod((e & f) ~ (~e & g2), 4294967296)
  local temp1 = mod(hh + S1 + ch + k + w, 4294967296)
  local S0 = mod(a ~ floor(a/4) ~ floor(a/16), 4294967296)
  local maj = mod((a & b) ~ (a & c) ~ (b & c), 4294967296)
  local temp2 = mod(S0 + maj, 4294967296)
  [mod(temp1+temp2,4294967296),a,b,c,mod(d+temp1,4294967296),e,f,g2]
}
local h256 = [0x6a09e667,0xbb67ae85,0x3c6ef372,0xa54ff53a,0x510e527f,0x9b05688c,0x1f83d9ab,0x5be0cd19]
println(sha256_round(h256, 0x61626380, 0x428a2f98))

9843.answer:
func hexXOR(a, b) = {
  local hexChars = "0123456789abcdef"
  local result = ""
  local i = 1
  while (i <= a.textLen()-1) {
    local pairA = a.segment(i,2)
    local pairB = b.segment(i,2)
    local valA = hexToDec(pairA)
    local valB = hexToDec(pairB)
    local xored = valA ~ valB
    result = result _ hexChars.segment(floor(xored/16)+1,1) _ hexChars.segment(mod(xored,16)+1,1)
    i = i + 2
  }
  result
}

9936.answer:
func turboCode_encode(bits) = {
  local parity1 = []
  local parity2 = []
  local state1 = 0
  local state2 = 0
  for (b in bits) {
    parity1.add(mod(b + state1, 2))
    state1 = mod(state1 + b, 2)
    local scrambled = bits.random()
    parity2.add(mod(scrambled + state2, 2))
    state2 = mod(state2 + scrambled, 2)
  }
  [bits, parity1, parity2]
}

10160.answer:
func zkProof_sim(statement, witness, verifier) = {
  local commitment = mod(witness * witness, statement)
  local challenge = randInt(0, statement-1)
  local response = mod(witness + challenge, statement)
  local check = mod(response * response, statement) == mod(commitment + challenge * statement, statement)
  if (check || mod(witness*witness,statement)==mod(commitment,1)) "verified" else "rejected"
}
println(zkProof_sim(97, 5, 1))
